description: Lybra configuration schema - structure and sources for all configuration, NO hardcoded values in code

lybra_dir_authority.description: AIPOS-R6S 大项C④: .lybra 配置源的权威关系 — 工位级 vs 机器级。连接器/CLI 的 gate_url/actor/token/policy 自发现必须先锚定工位级 .lybra(会话 cwd 向上找), 机器级 ~/.lybra/local 只是回退(第二源), 永不与工位级混用。gate 工作区(队列/records)与产品仓(最终化/git)的 workspace_root 语义同族拆分, 见 resolveGateWorkspace/resolveCodeRepo。

sources.name: workstation
sources.note: 同机多角色各自锚定自己的工位, 禁从治理仓 workspaceRoot 找 .lybra (锚点错 = 同机全解析成同一身份)

sources.name: machine
sources.note: 只在工位级缺失时作回退读; 工位级存在时永不优先。今晨 loop 取到域名 URL 即因读了机器级 → 现为隐式第二源, 此处定死

sources.name: env
sources.note: env 仅覆盖, 优先级最低, 不构成权威源

lybra_dir_authority.same_host_rule: 同机时 gate_url 一律 loopback (http://127.0.0.1:<port>), 免疫代理劫道 (AIPOS-R6K 契约)
lybra_dir_authority.precedence: 显式参数 > 工位 .lybra (primary) > 机器级 ~/.lybra/local (fallback) > env (lowest)

ports.description: Service port configuration — single source for all port defaults. AIPOS-R4B-1: code reads these via schema_loader.get_config_port(); the 35 hardcoded 7117/7118 references in tools/ (non-test) route through here. board_default added (was missing: board port 7117 had no single source).

timeouts.description: Timeout configuration — single source for all timeout defaults. 坑② 修复(R5B前置): timeoutMs 从配置读取,不写死。顾问实测证明网络路径等速(127.0.0.1 vs tailscale 均 2.2s/461卡),真凶在连接器内部预算累加(initialize+queueTasks+claimDryRun+taskPreview 串行)。
timeouts.gate_mcp_request_description: Gate MCP 单次请求超时(ms)。默认 30s 对齐 LOOP-REDESIGN 护栏常量审查;实测本机单次操作 <3s,30s 为多次串行累加留足容错预算。计时日志(fetch-timing/dryrun-timing/preview-timing/tick-total-timing)用于排查慢点。

governance_structure.description: Governance repository fixed directory structure - read from workspace config, NOT hardcoded

stage_archive.description: Stage completion archive directory (AIPOS-R6M 大项A③: stage粒度门票机制 — 单一源, 与 n6_closure_checklist/governance_worktree whitelist 同用此键)
stage_archive.structure: <date>_<stage-name>.md (历史快照, 最新一篇=当前坐标)
stage_archive.semantics: 阶段粒度·低频·阶段关账才写 - 三个月后的人只读最新一篇+其后decision_log即可上手

decision_log_dir.description: Decision log directory (AIPOS-R6M 大项A②: decision粒度机器触发)
decision_log_dir.semantics: 决策粒度·事件驱动·当天落 - 只记改变未来行为规则的单点决定

task_cards.description: Task cards archive directory (AIPOS-R7A2 FIX-2: N6 收账清单第①件台账条目)
task_cards.semantics: 任务台账条目 - 每张卡完成后留存 RETURN.md/AUDIT-REPORT.md/CLOSURE.md 等归档文件

foundation_backlog.description: Foundation backlog (AIPOS-R6M 大项A①: card粒度编年史)
foundation_backlog.semantics: 卡粒度编年史 - close时校验本卡条目存在(或excuse_ref豁免)

timeline_enforcement.description: AIPOS-R6M 大项A: 三粒度机器触发机制 (Owner 2026-08-15终裁: 名字、目录内命名、记与不记, 全是机器的事)

card_level.check: FOUNDATION-BACKLOG.md contains task_id entry OR closure_evidence.excuse_ref present
card_level.rationale: 原'decision_log每卡追加'语义废除(73次无人理WARN遗迹), 改为卡编年史校验

decision_level.content: 一句话结论 + decided_by + 指向记录路径 (固化命名)
decision_level.enforcement: automatic (silent failure does not block main flow)

stage_level.trigger: stage transition actions (阶段关账/迁移门/发布门, e.g. finalize)
stage_level.check: governance_structure.paths.stage_archive 指向的目录存在且含至少一篇阶段快照(.md, 排除 README.md/index)
stage_level.rationale: 阶段快照=转换前提, 缺快照=未关账=不许转换

n6_closure_checklist.description: N6 closure node governance updates checklist - what files to update on task completion

updates.description: Append task completion decision to decision log
Update relevant sections in project status
Update roadmap if task affects milestones
Move task card to completed queue
Archive stage completion documentation (on stage boundary)

final_action.description: Push all governance updates to remote (push is part of N6 node)

path_conventions.description: Path conventions used throughout the system

environment_variables.description: Environment variables that can override config file values

multi_project_support.description: Multi-project configuration - gate serves multiple projects

project_registry.description: Gate maintains registry of all projects

scope_isolation.description: All operations scoped by (project, instance) tuple

governance_worktree.description: AIPOS-R5B: Per-project governance worktree configuration — 解决 FND-24 多项目共用一工作树推送相撞。复用 R5A worktree_manager.py 一机制一实现。

gov_prefix.description: 收集车道(collection lane)非特性分叉 — 每次收账即 merge 回 main, 差距不过夜。与 LOOP-REDESIGN §6 '分叉活不过一张卡' 红线不冲突(语义声明在此, 非硬编码特判)。

card_prefix.description: 临时任务分支 — 分叉活不过一张卡, finalize 时 merge + 删分支 + 删 worktree
card_prefix.lifecycle: created on claim, deleted on finalize

path_constraints.description: AIPOS-R6A 靶子⑨: 治理仓路径白名单 — 明确哪些路径可写。代码文件(.py/.js/.ts等)一律禁止，只允许文档、记录、配置。
path_constraints.violation_policy: BLOCK with explicit file list. Code files in governance repo = protocol violation (治理仓从此无代码可改).

merge_convergence.description: merge 收敛动词 — 一条命令合所有 gov/<project> 回 main 并 push
merge_convergence.conflict_resolution: 目录隔离 → 零冲突预期; 真冲突 → 越界改他人目录 → BLOCK 列文件
merge_convergence.single_truth: origin main = 唯一真相, 禁第二 origin/镜像

coexistence.description: 共存期策略 — 现有直推 main 流程照常
coexistence.agency_chris_kaia_untouched: 本卡零接触 agency/chris 工作流, kaia-kb 只读
coexistence.migration_deferred: 切换另行安排, 非本卡范围
